title: Engineering Sync: Zero-Downtime Neon Database Migration

transcript.speaker: Alex Rivera
transcript.text: Hey team, this is our final pre-flight sync before executing the database migration to Neon serverless PostgreSQL tonight at 02:00 UTC.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: All synthetic read/write health checks passed on our staging environment. Connection pooling with PgBouncer handled 2,000 concurrent websocket connections without dropping a single packet.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Brody
transcript.text: I verified all GIN indexes on meetings, transcript utterances, and action items. Search query times dropped from 320ms to 18ms.

transcript.speaker: Alex Rivera
transcript.text: What is our rollback plan in the unlikely event of replication drift during the 5-minute read-only window?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: We maintain dual-writes for 60 minutes post-cutover. If error rate exceeds 0.05%, DNS and database connection strings revert automatically in under 15 seconds.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Brody
transcript.text: I will monitor query telemetry and slow query logs during the first 2 hours post-cutover.

transcript.speaker: Alex Rivera
transcript.text: Sounds like we are 100% prepared. Let's reconvene on the incident channel at 01:45 UTC tonight.

analysis.executiveSummary: Final pre-flight engineering review for the Neon Serverless PostgreSQL migration scheduled for 02:00 UTC. Load testing confirmed 2,000 concurrent connection capacity with PgBouncer and an 18ms search response time via GIN indexing. Automated rollback and 60-minute dual-write safety windows were confirmed.
keyTakeaways: Cutover window scheduled for tonight at 02:00 UTC with automated health checks.
GIN full-text search indexing verified, reducing query latency from 320ms to 18ms.
Rollback mechanism verified: automated DNS switchover under 15 seconds if error rate exceeds 0.05%.
Post-migration monitoring: Marcus Brody handling telemetry and query analysis for 2 hours post-launch.

actionItems.task: Initiate read-only maintenance banner in app UI at 01:55 UTC
Monitor connection pool metrics and PgBouncer saturation on production dashboard
Verify full-text search GIN index consistency and log query times

decisions.decision: Execute production database cutover to Neon at 02:00 UTC with 60-minute dual-write safety window
decisions.rationale: Historical traffic is at minimum weekly baseline, minimizing disruption.

potentialRisks.risk: Temporary connection spikes during DNS TTL expiration if clients cache old IP address.
potentialRisks.mitigation: Set DNS TTL to 60 seconds 24 hours ahead of cutover.
